content: Melvin-Koushki dates the R. Shaqq-i Qamar to the beginning of 829/1426. His footnote adds that this is the same year as Ibn Turka's second trial in Herat and as the composition of his first, 'hyper-Sunni' apology, the Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I (together with the R. Iʿtiqādāt). The page draws no conclusion from the coincidence.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
